title: RTP-LX: Can LLMs Evaluate Toxicity in Multilingual Scenarios?

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model performance (agreement with human annotators via Cohen's kappa) in detecting toxicity across 28 different languages, and explicitly analyzing the correlation between model performance and the language's online data availability (high-resource vs. low-resource languages).

Assessing models on a human-transcreated and manually curated dataset of culturally-specific toxic prompts to measure their ability to detect subtle, context-dependent harmful content and localisms that are specific to distinct geographical locales.

Prompting S/LLMs to classify text for 'Bias', 'Identity Attack', and 'Microaggression' categories to evaluate their capacity to identify stereotyping, denigration, and subtle harms targeting specific demographic groups or ideologies.
